scope: Additive WAS-NYG final-source gate after official NFL and New York Giants surfaces reached Final. Reuses the immutable Week 10 carried board, verified full current-information review, official final inactive list, final injury designations and same-day roster/elevation facts. Binds Washington 24, New York Giants 21. At the observation cutoff the official NFL game center had reached Final but did not expose a downloadable final gamebook; complete starters, substitutes, participation/DNP, printed injury/return, specialist and official snap coverage remain explicit UNRESOLVED fields. No started-game prediction, fair, carried rating, historical receipt, completed baseline receipt or market field is changed.
estimationPolicy: Factual preparation only. Missing participation, exposure, replacements and values are not zero. An official final score and final inactive list without the complete final gamebook do not support a paired numerical evaluation. No new numerical method is authorized.

sources.finding: Official New York Giants recap records Washington defeating New York 24-21. It identifies Jayden Daniels and J.J. McCarthy as the primary quarterbacks, the Giants' 66-yard fourth-quarter go-ahead touchdown and Washington's 32-yard go-ahead touchdown to Stefon Diggs with 57 seconds remaining.

Fresh official NFL game center reached Final and exposed recap, stats and highlights navigation but no Download Game Book link or PDF URL. Complete official participation pages, printed injury/return annotations and snap tables were not available at the stopping boundary.

Official Giants notice lists New York inactives Paulson Adebo, J.C. Davis, Thomas Fidone II, Malik Harrison, C.J. Okoye, Nikko Reed and Josh Sills; Washington inactives Ricky Barber, Athan Kaliakmanis (third quarterback), Lucas Patrick, Tanoa Togiai, Colson Yankoff and Isaac Yiadom. It also records New York elevations Dawuane Smoot and Chandler Martin, and Washington's Ale Kaho signing and Julian Good-Jones elevation.

Official final injury report lists Washington center Lucas Patrick (concussion) and tight end Colson Yankoff (knee) Out, and New York linebacker Malik Harrison (groin) Questionable. It records J.J. McCarthy, Cam Skattebo and the other listed Giants without final game designations, while preserving Washington's listed participation statuses. The report does not classify every other final inactive as injury-driven or healthy.
Immutable issued board binds the Week 10 kickoff time, carried ratings, H4, governed QB differential and exact/displayed pregame fair. The issued NYG -0.5 prediction remains frozen after kickoff.
Verified full Week 10 current-information review preserves the source-bound Washington and New York categorical findings, original receipt/runtime limitations and zero unsupported numerical moves.
